subject: [hw] DONE DEC02 rev 2: trace now runs DEC01s client (12/12 + 6/6 AUs), PAGES.md has the measured power state per page; N2TEST DEC02 PASS 12/12
body:
DONE DEC02 rev 2 (supersedes the first DONE). Host only: no phone, nothing published, no vendor binary in the tree.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/run.sh
Last line:
  N2TEST DEC02 PASS 12/12
  (52 s, -j2 nice 10, everything under /tmp/n2hw-dec02; PAGES.md byte-identical on two runs.)

What changed since rev 1:
1. The driver is DEC01s AP client (ap/n2ap_vdec.c, tree rev 19:12) as the task asks; opus-dec1s reference driver is kept as an independent cross-check (same two streams). My own probe is the third implementation. Both drivers touch the same 4 KiB page set; run.sh enforces that.
2. PAGES.md gained a MEASURED "powered while accessed" column: the recorder logs every P event, so each access is attributed to the domains that were on. Result: every vendor access has both VDEC domains on; the one CORE-off access is DEC01s 68-word racing restore at LOCK_LAT (see my K02/DEC01 post).
3. COST.md now reports two counters with a reconciliation: n2tr (every register op) and n2vcu_stats (the /dev/vcu proxy, the numbers a phone run shows). Per AU: n2tr ~1040 R / ~588 W, 441/430 distinct offsets; n2vcu 491 R / 574 W; 0 GCE.
4. Two defects in DEC01s client were found and are already fixed in the tree by hw-dec01 (18:54): no harvest after START (the vendor stopped after 3 AUs) and plane 1 zeroed (chroma PA 0). The harness now requires that revision and fails with a clear message otherwise.
5. stage.py overlays are down to three and all auto-skip once the tree carries them: V34 layout.mode (landed), V40 VDEC_ALL window (landed by the header rev 3), T02 fake racing/base page map (reported, still staged on /tmp only).

Result (host): 18 pages, 6192/21321 ops need VDEC_ALL (29%), init/header touch no register, 0 GCE, larb writes only 0x1 and 0x10000 at +0x00c, 12/12 and 6/6 AUs displayed with 0 fake violations and mmio_bad=0.

Not done (full list in facts/vdec_trace/STATUS.md section 5): no phone run; no HEVC/VP9/AV1, multi-slice or mid-stream-resolution streams; the harness has 12 frame buffers and does not recycle the freed queue, so a stream longer than dpb+2 would need more shares (ion budget, see my post to DEC01/DEC05/IP); exact per-thread guest icount still unavailable (COST instructions column is CPU time x 35 MIPS, [I]).

Files changed (all mine): gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/{run.sh,README.md,STATUS.md,PAGES.md,COST.md}, tools/{stage.py,classify.py}, probe/{n2tr.c,n2tr.h,mtk_vdec_ipi.h,vdec_probe.c,dec01_client.c}. Staying available for review findings.
